status: frozen after V19W2 passed all five implementation failure classes, while the unchanged base V19W process was still running, before reading a base final report, enumerating its final missing cells, creating a recovery product, combining a spectrum, opening a lensing payload, or changing gravity physics
purpose: After the frozen base process exits normally, derive the recovery workload as the frozen 5082-cell manifest minus every independently valid base checkpoint, apply the commissioned exact-binmap response path to every missing or invalid cell, and independently audit one unified 5082-cell index without modifying or copying over the base archive.

recovery_definition.workload: every frozen V19U manifest task lacking a base completed checkpoint that passes task identity, preflight counts, all cell gates, PHA histograms and links, ARF/RMF audit, product sizes and SHA-256
recovery_definition.source_and_background_membership: exact frozen V19M integer binmap mask as commissioned by V19W2
recovery_definition.response_reference: actual selected 0.5-7 keV event nearest the DETX/DETY centroid, converted through the observation's unreprojected detector frame and required to map to the declared CCD_ID
recovery_definition.zero_background_rule: source-only weighted response plus an exact zero-count background PHA and ordinary BACKFILE/AREASCAL audits
recovery_definition.base_precedence: use a valid base checkpoint; use a recovery checkpoint only when the base checkpoint is absent or independently invalid

failure_rule: Fail closed and retain recovery diagnostics. Never delete, quarantine, replace, relink or otherwise modify a base V19W checkpoint. Do not drop a manifest cell, alter its binmap label, change response settings, retry a failed recovery under the same protocol, combine spectra, or authorize V19X after an incomplete unified audit.
claim_boundary: V19W3 repairs and audits response products; it does not combine or interpret a spectrum.
The final workload is unknown at freeze and is determined only from the terminal base report plus an independent checkpoint audit.
A pass authorizes freezing a successor V19X configuration that understands the two-archive unified index; it does not make the original single-archive V19X configuration valid.
No temperature, density, Mach state, long-wave parameter, lensing target, halo map or gravity formula enters recovery selection.
